information.description:
While their name is vicious sounding, Hunters are basically just the new recruits of the Tyger Claws. They can smack you with a stick, and have some face-mask gear for intimidation purposes, but aren’t quite the ferocious predators the gang is known for.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Tyger Claws).

description.value: Throwing hands, does not ignore half armor.
Simple Leather armor for your head. No armor penalty.
